title: The exceptional set for Diophantine inequality with mixed powers of primes
summary: Assume that $λ_1, λ_2, λ_3,λ_4,λ_5,λ_6,λ_7$ are non-zero real numbers , $λ_1/λ_2$ is an irrational number. Let $\mathcal{V} $ be a well-spaced sequence, and $δ>0$. For any given positive integer $k\geq 5$ and any $\varepsilon >0$, we give the upper bound of the number of $\upsilon \in \mathcal{V} $ with $\upsilon \leq X$ for which the inequality $$ \left | λ_1p_1^2 + λ_2p_2^3 + λ_3p_3^3 + λ_4p_4^3 + λ_5p_5^3 + λ_6p_6^4 + λ_7p_7^k - \upsilon \right | <{\upsilon}^{-δ} $$ has no solution in primes $p_1, p_2, p_3, p_4, p_5, p_6, p_7$.
